name: 500px

sources.title: 500px signup — returned empty JS shell to automated fetch; account creation requires JavaScript

requirements: 500px is a photography community/marketplace — only photography-portfolio profiles are native; a SaaS product has no listing surface beyond a branded account
Free account tier exists; paid tiers add portfolio features and licensing options (not required for a basic profile)
Signup page is a JS app shell — must be driven in a real browser
preparation: A small set of quality photos to upload — an empty profile has no presence value
Website URL for the profile link field
workflow: Open https://500px.com/signup in a JS-capable browser and create the account
Complete the profile: display name, avatar, bio, website link
Upload representative images so the profile is not empty
Verify the public profile at 500px.com/p/<user> renders for logged-out viewers
watchFor: Very weak fit for a SaaS launch — only useful as a branded profile citation, and only if photography content is relevant to the product
Profile outbound links are likely nofollow (not verified on-site)
Site is JS-heavy; automated verification of profile fields was not possible in this research pass
Do not upload marketing screenshots as 'photography' — mismatched content can be reported
countsAsLive: A public photographer profile page on 500px.com renders logged-out showing uploads and the website link
unknowns: Whether profile website links are follow or nofollow
Whether brand/product accounts are permitted or restricted to photographers
